# scm_dlp_alert_settings (Resource)

Manages Enterprise DLP alert settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Incident notification and alert exemption settings (singleton).
resource "scm_dlp_alert_settings" "default" {
  incident_notification_enablement   = true
  detection_exemption_period_minutes = 60
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `detection_exemption_period_minutes` (Number) Alert detection exemption period in minutes (1 to 129600).
- `incident_notification_enablement` (Boolean) Enable incident notifications.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Alert settings identifier.
- `tfid` (String) Terraform identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: import using the fixed ID "alert_settings".
terraform import scm_dlp_alert_settings.example alert_settings
```
